canonical.name: Jordan Avery Reyes
canonical.harms: I have received unwanted inquiries about this dismissed case when people find the electronic case record online.
canonical.protection: Removing remote access would reduce those unwanted inquiries. The courthouse record would remain available in person.
canonical.scope: My request concerns remote access to this criminal case only. I am not asking to delete or seal the records.

boundary.name: Alexandrina Katherine Montgomery Reyes
boundary.reason: The court entered an acquittal after trial.
boundary.harms: I have received repeated unwanted inquiries from people who found the electronic case record. They continue asking about a charge of which I was acquitted. I want to explain that harm in my own words rather than have another person supply a statement for me.
boundary.protection: I believe limiting remote access would reduce those inquiries and the resulting loss of privacy. This request leaves access at the courthouse available. These statements are synthetic facts for a diagnostic fixture, not a declaration by a real person.
boundary.scope: I request the limited remote-access remedy for this case. I do not request expungement or sealing, and I understand that the public may still obtain the records in person at the courthouse.
